# Guileo AI

> Guileo is one house for a business's growth: an AI that answers calls and messages, books and sells 24/7 in 16 languages, plus a team that runs ads, marketing and content and builds websites, apps and custom software. Most businesses go live in 7 days. Self-service plans start at $149/month with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

Guileo serves businesses in the United States and Brazil. The AI covers what a team can't — nights, weekends, simultaneous calls and follow-ups — and a real person supervises and takes over when needed. It answers in the customer's language automatically, including English, Portuguese, Spanish and Hindi. Guileo is operated by ORIGEM LTDA; founder Luis Teles; contact smart@guileoai.com.

## Product and pricing

- [Home](https://guileoai.com/): what Guileo does, how it works and the most common questions
- [Plans](https://guileoai.com/planos): Essential $149/mo, Personalized $897/mo, Full Operation $1,997/mo; tailored done-for-you packages are quoted per business
- [Services](https://guileoai.com/servicos): AI receptionist, booking, lead capture, ads, marketing, websites and apps
- [Lead generation](https://guileoai.com/lead-generation): finding and following up with new customers
- [Marketing](https://guileoai.com/marketing): ads, content and campaigns run by the team
- [Go live](https://guileoai.com/go-live): the activation checklist — pay, connect the cockpit, forward the line, load the menu and go live
- [Missed-calls calculator](https://guileoai.com/calculator): estimate the revenue lost to unanswered calls
